Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a mistake in Step 4 by instructing WebSurfer to click on a link (`https://nas.er.usgs.gov/queries/FactSheet.aspx`) that was not present on the Bing search results page shown in the previous step. The visible search results listed URLs like `https://nas.er.usgs.gov › queries › FactSheet.aspx` as part of a breadcrumb or title structure, but the specific direct URL for the American Alligator fact sheet (`...speciesID=221`) was not clickable text on the Bing page. This hallucinated action led to a confusing interaction where WebSurfer reported clicking a control but the viewport remained at the top of the page without loading the specific species data containing the year 1976. The Orchestrator failed to correctly interpret the search results to generate a valid instruction, causing the agent to fail in retrieving the correct information from the intended source.
